bill.title: A bill to amend the Controlled Substances Act to schedule MGM-15 and MGM-16 as schedule I controlled substances, and to amend the controlled Substances Act to schedule synthetic 7-hydroxymitragynine, and Mitragynine Pseudoindoxyl, as a Schedule I above a specific threshold under the controlled substance act, and to expand enforcement actions against drug manufacturers and distributors of emerging synthetic opioids, commonly known as gas station heroin.

action.description: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

posted_text:
⚖️ Criminal Justice & Policing
US S 5383 — New Synthetic Opioids Added to List of Most Dangerous Drugs

Congress is moving to classify MGM-15 and MGM-16, along with synthetic 7-hydroxymitragynine and Mitragynine Pseudoindoxyl, as Schedule I drugs. This means these substances – often found in emerging synthetic opioids nicknamed ‘gas station heroin’ – will face the strictest federal controls. .. .... ..
